Class SolverMultiOpen

java.lang.Object
solvers.SolverMulti
solvers.multiSolverAlgorithms.SolverMultiOpen
public class SolverMultiOpen extends SolverMulti
Solves a multiclass open model with the classical queueing network algorithms, as described in the JMVA chapter of the JMT user manual (load dependent stations are not allowed in open models).
Author:
Federico Granata, Stefano Omini, Bertoli Marco
